title: A pushed block in the trap's sights
description: The player pushes a stone block along a corridor and into the stretch an arrow trap watches, stopping just short of it himself: the block moves into the trap's sights and nothing fires. Then he jumps over the block into the stretch, and the trap fires, missing him.
